name: Research task or finding
about: Coordinate an area or document a claim with evidence

## Area and scope
Which functions, file format, or subsystem? Check existing issues before claiming work.

## Evidence
Game version, addresses, callers, and a concise description of the observed behavior.
Distinguish observed facts, inference, and unknowns. Do not upload raw game code or assets.

## Next step
What bounded investigation or validation would resolve this?
